name: shimmer-trace
description: High-performance React skeleton loaders that automatically trace your UI dimensions. Synchronized animations, zero CLS, and one-line implementation.

scripts.size: npm run build && esbuild dist/index.mjs --bundle --minify --external:react --external:react-dom --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.min.mjs --metafile=dist/meta.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),zlib=require('zlib');const b=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.min.mjs');console.log('min:',(b.length/1024).toFixed(2)+'kB','gzip:',(zlib.gzipSync(b,{level:9}).length/1024).toFixed(2)+'kB','brotli:',(zlib.brotliCompressSync(b).length/1024).toFixed(2)+'kB')"

author: Jeet Vora
